category: hosted Mac build and simulator service for coding agents
tier: Prepaid credit with a USD 10 starter grant

free_tier.stated: USD 10 of prepaid credit for a new account, about 200 Mac minutes at USD 0.05 a Mac minute; whole minutes only and a job under a minute is free; no subscription or minimum
free_tier.notes: The USD 10 grant is a one-time starter credit, not a recurring monthly allowance. Uploading, waiting in line and starting the Mac are not billed. The credit is prepaid; there is no card charge described at signup.

per_object_cap.stated: not an object-storage offer; no per-file size ceiling is published on the landing or setup pages

retention.stated: each user gets their own macOS VM and its build cache stays between runs; unused for 14 days and all of it is deleted, or immediately with macbox purge; a device build archive is kept for 24 hours

egress.terms: the VM can reach the internet but cannot reach other VMs or the provider network; no transfer allowance or per-GB price is published

interface_detail: a macbox CLI and an MCP server that exposes build, test, run, screenshot and simulator interaction tools to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents; setup uses the guide at api.macbox.build/guide
tooling: one CLI installed with curl or a package manager, plus an API key obtained at signup; agents call macbox commands or the MCP tools, and the Xcode-facing tools run MobileBuildMCP on the hosted Mac
chaining: an agent runs macbox build and macbox test from a Linux or cloud sandbox, gets a live simulator link for run and ui interactions, and receives a signed-off-device archive to sign and upload elsewhere.

limits.value: USD 0.05 per Mac minute, whole minutes only, a job under a minute is free; prepaid credit with no subscription or minimums, USD 10 at signup
a live session ends at macbox stop, on the next build/test/run in the folder, after 10 minutes with nobody watching, or at the 30-minute job limit
sign-in is GitHub OAuth requesting read:user and user:email; a cloud agent needs a key added as the MACBOX_API_KEY secret

limits_note: Native iOS Xcode projects, workspaces, Swift packages, CocoaPods and XcodeGen are supported on the iOS simulator; React Native, Flutter, signing and TestFlight are not supported by the service itself. The VM has no inbound access to other VMs or the provider network.
binding_note: The prepaid credit at USD 0.05 a minute is what depletes first for repeated builds; the 30-minute job and 10-minute unwatched-session caps bound each run.

identity_cost.detail: the setup guide says the user signs in with GitHub and a new account gets USD 10 of credit; the sign-in page is a GitHub OAuth prompt asking for a GitHub username or email address and password and requesting read:user and user:email scopes. No card field appears at signup; a cloud agent uses a key added as a secret instead of an interactive login.

reliability_note: The macOS VM is isolated: it reaches the internet but not other VMs or the provider network. It is deleted after 14 days unused, or immediately with macbox purge. A live session ends after 10 minutes without a viewer or at the 30-minute job limit. Signing and TestFlight are not performed by the service.
confidence_note: the landing page, setup guide and public sign-in form were read on 2026-11-25; the quoted lines establish the price, starter credit, signup gate and retention rules. The rung stays documented because no live build was measured.
